archimate:Outcome.name: Improved Clinical Consistency and Reduced Variation in Treatment
archimate:Outcome.documentation:
This outcome ensures that patients receive standardized care regardless of the healthcare provider or facility. It reduces unnecessary differences in treatment decisions, diagnostic procedures, and patient management approaches.
The purpose of this outcome is to enhance the quality and equity of healthcare services across the health system. It also minimizes avoidable treatment errors and inconsistent patient outcomes.
Example: Patients with diabetes receive the same laboratory monitoring and medication protocols across regional health centers.
